lines.label: Calleem answers
lines.stepLabel: Picks up on the first ring, 24/7
lines.text: Thanks for calling Bluebonnet Plumbing! Is this an emergency, or would you like to book a visit?

lines.label: Caller explains
lines.stepLabel: A homeowner with a leaking water heater
lines.text: It's an emergency, my water heater is leaking all over the garage.

lines.label: Safety first
lines.stepLabel: Walks the caller through a quick fix
lines.text: Okay, let's stop the water first. Turn the cold-water valve on top of the heater clockwise until it stops.

lines.label: Takes the details
lines.text: Great. Can I get your name and the address of the house?

lines.label: Caller shares address
lines.text: Mike Johnson, 2418 Oak Street in Dallas.

lines.label: Finds a slot
lines.stepLabel: Checks the schedule in real time
lines.text: Thanks, Mike. Our earliest emergency slot is 2 PM today. Does that work?

lines.label: Books the job
lines.text: You're booked for 2 PM today, and I'm texting you the details now.
